# The symptom is in the PIX "numbering" pass, which never runs during an
# ordinary dxc compile, so the "compiler" for this issue is run-2923.cmd --
# the four-tool pipeline PixTest.cpp's RunAnnotationPasses performs
# (dxc -> dxa -extractpart=dbgmodule -> dxopt PIX passes -> opt -S), followed
# by check-2923.py, which reports the resulting virtual-register numbering.
# It is registered as the compiler id `main-debug-pix`; see method-notes.md.
#
# -Od is the reporter's plainest case. The unit test named in the issue also
# covers -O1; that is captured as variant-o1-main-debug-pix.txt.
repro.hlsl -Od
